title: Page 7
content_zh:
「咳，」他好像也有些尴尬。「你是煮饭的人，我总不希望吃菜的时候吃到头发。」
虽然他这么解释，可是他怎么可能会因为这样就送礼物给厨房女佣，况且虽然她现在很穷，但以前可也是千金小姐，又怎么看不出那个发夹是出自某家名牌的设计……
「这太、太贵重了……我、我以后煮饭会戴头巾，所以你不用……」因为太紧张了，叶咏欢不由得口吃起来，虽然她也搞不懂自己是在紧张什么。
「啰唆！我给你的你敢不收？」
他又回复冷硬的恶劣态度，一把将她扯进怀里，然后擅自帮她把头发挽起来，夹上发夹。
跟那怒气冲冲的语气不同的是，他的动作好温柔……
叶咏欢羞得连耳根都红了，不用说，露出的颈项也红通通的。他的气息很近，她可以闻到他的味道，感觉到他的体热，她心跳快到好像就要晕倒似的。
「我、我去煮饭了。」她连忙退开。
不行，太可怕了！这样的距离、这样的亲昵，太容易就让人沉沦，再次的产生不当的期待。
她躲进厨房，脸上的红潮久久没有办法消退。
他干麽要送她东西？他干麽请人来分担她的工作？他是在关心她吗？他是不是有一些在乎她？还是一切都是她想太多？
叶咏欢整颗心都乱了，却无能为力。
「啊！」
指尖传来刺痛，猛然拉回她的神智，她无奈的发现自己竟然在分心的情况下割伤手指。
痛痛痛……
她撕了张纸巾包住手指，得去找个OK绷止血，否则万一血滴进食物里就不好了，他连头发都要管了，想必很重视食物的卫生。
叶咏欢走出厨房，不可避免的撞见在客厅看书的他。
她低着头，他却注意到她包着纸巾的手指。
「怎么了？」
「呃……」她吓了一跳，因为他丢下手中的书，快速的跑到她面前，她没看过他这么紧张兮兮的样子。「我切到手了，对不起，笨手笨脚的。」

「去医院！」
「什、什么？！拜托，不用啦！」
天！会不会太夸张了？！
「万一细菌感染怎么办？」
看他严肃认真的说出这种话，她简直要晕倒了。她以前怎么会认为他是世界上最聪明的人，还崇拜他崇拜得要命？
这个苏劲沧是她以前认识的那个吗？
「不可能啦！这种程度的伤口只要碘酒擦一擦，OK绷包起来就好了。」
「是吗？」
她简直要翻白眼叹气了。「是啦！」
他扬起的眉还带着意思狐疑，不过最后总算不情愿的点点头。「跟我来，书房有急救箱。」
他亲自帮她上药，慎重的表情让她的手不禁微微颤抖。
「痛吗？」
「还、还好。」他语气的温柔给她的震撼还比较大。
「是吗？」
擦完药很久，他始终不放开她的手。「我记得你以前很怕痛的，一点点痛就忍不住要哭了。」
她的脸烧红了，听他提起以前，不知怎的，有种异样的暧昧情愫在流动。她不知道他是故意的还是无心，总之，她不想碰触「以前」这种危险的话题，于是她赶紧说道：「那是以前，我已经长大了。」
「是吗？」他失神，像是有片刻的失落。「我希望你永远不要改变。」然后他看着她，伸出手，碰触她的脸、耳朵，抚摸她的颈项，像是在确定什么。
她被下了定身咒般一动也无法动。
为什么他要这样？为什么要用这种眼神看她？为什么要碰她？
她微微张开嘴，想呐喊出这些问题，可是喉咙像是被卡住，发不出声音。

他向她靠近，他独有的气息盈满她的感官，她觉得一阵晕眩。
他对着她微笑，那俊美的笑叫她看傻了，然后他的唇吻住发呆的她……
她眨眼、再眨眼，眼前放大的男性脸孔并没有消失，所以不是梦！
她惊喘一声，蓦然领悟到发生什么事，推开他，狼狈的往后退开。「不！」
他蹙眉，想要把她来回来，可是她太惊恐了，甩开他的手，逃也似的跑开。
她被吓坏了，真的吓坏了！
他不应该用那种表情看她、他不应该碰她、不应该吻她……
乱了，一切都乱了……
回家的路上，苏劲沧破天荒的绕到百货公司。
平常除了自己的衣服，大部分的物品他都叫助理或秘书代买，更别说一半送礼。他不喜欢购物，觉得那是浪费时间。
可是这星期他第二天走进百货公司。
上回在珠宝专柜买了一个发夹，这回他走进一家冰淇淋专卖店。
「先生请问需要什么吗？」
三个售货小姐一拥而上，她们很少看到这样高大英挺的男性顾客上门，每个人都期待跟他说上几句话，就算没有业绩也无所谓。
「我要冰淇淋，送人的。」今天他特地向女秘书打听哪家的冰淇淋最好吃，他以前从没有花心思注意咏欢她喜欢什么，只记得那年去德国时她吃冰淇淋吃得很开心。
「请问对方是怎样的年纪？」
「年轻女性。」
售货小姐互看一眼，在对方的眼中都看见失望，这样条件好的男士果然是有心上人了呢！
「我们的冰淇淋强调纯天然制造，有不同口味可以选择，这几种都很受年轻女性喜爱……」售货小姐一一介绍。
苏劲沧听得很仔细，每一种都尝了尝，甜腻的味道令他皱眉。真不知道那家伙为什么爱吃……

他最后还是无法决定，就买了一打。购物过程虽然浪费很多时间，可想到她收到礼物那种又开心又惊喜的样子就很愉悦。
以前他怎么都不知道买东西给别人是这么快乐的一件事？一种想要宠对方、给对方任何她想要的东西的冲动，那么强烈，他是第一次感觉到。他想起过去，无论他要什么，即使是她再心爱的，她都愿意给他。
她说他是她心中的第一位，现在他似乎有点了解这种心情了。
把另一个人的需要放在自己之上，那好像是件很愚蠢而危险的事情。不过，他想他不用担心，因为自己的心情对方也会相等的回报。
对她，他很有把握，他相信她还是爱他的，只要对她好一点，送点礼物，哄哄她，很快她就会再像以前那样对他痴迷爱恋。
「一共是两千五百元。先生，你的女朋友真幸福，有个疼她的男朋友。」
售货小姐的话他只是笑笑没有反驳，结果沉重的两大袋。
吃冰淇淋时，她可能又会展露以前那种幸福的笑容吧？
怀着这样的期待，他高兴的付完钱，拎着冰淇淋回家。
第8章(2)
回到家，他迫不及待的走进厨房。
「你、你好。」
他不喜欢她每次看到他时戒慎恐惧的神情，不过他相信今天他的秘密武器可以让她卸下心防。
「晚餐马上好。」
「不急，这是要给你吃的。」
叶咏欢愕然的看着他递过来的两大袋冰淇淋。
「你喜欢吃对吗？」
她张开口，却说不出话来。
看到她的反应，苏劲沧心里窃喜。
她马上就会开心的笑了对吧？他仿佛可以看到她舔冰淇淋时幸福的表情，然后她会感谢他，也许他还可以要来一个吻。

他记得吻她的感觉，比所有冰淇淋都还来得甜……
「不。」
她的回答让他不悦的皱起眉。
「你说『不』是什么意思？」
「我不能接受你的礼物。」她把冰淇淋塞回他手里。
那种全然推拒的态度让他感到恼怒，然后她接下来的话更令他震惊。
content_en:
"Ahem," he seemed a little embarrassed. "You are the one who cooks. I don't want to get hair on my face when eating vegetables."
Although he explained this, how could he give a gift to the kitchen maid just because of this? Besides, although she is very poor now, she used to be a wealthy lady. How could he not tell that the hairpin was designed by a certain famous brand...
"This is too, too expensive... I, I will wear a headscarf when cooking in the future, so you don't have to..." Ye Yonghuan couldn't help but stutter because she was so nervous, although she couldn't figure out why she was nervous.
"How dare you not accept what I gave you?"
He returned to his cold and bad attitude, pulled her into his arms, and then helped her pull up her hair and put on hairpins without authorization.
Different from his angry tone, his movements were so gentle...
Ye Yonghuan was so embarrassed that her ears turned red. Needless to say, her exposed neck was also red. His breath was so close that she could smell him and feel his body heat. Her heartbeat was so fast that she seemed about to faint.
"I-I'm going to cook." She quickly backed away.
No, it’s too terrible! Such distance and intimacy make people sink too easily, once again creating inappropriate expectations.
She hid in the kitchen, the blush on her face not going away for a long time.
Why did he want to give her something? Why did he hire someone to share her work? Does he care about her? Does he care about her? Or is she overthinking everything?
Ye Yonghuan's heart was in confusion, but there was nothing she could do.
"Ah!"
A stinging pain came from her fingertips, which suddenly brought her back to consciousness. She found helplessly that she had cut her finger while distracted.
It hurts...
She tore a piece of paper towel and wrapped it around her finger. She had to find a bandage to stop the bleeding, otherwise it would be bad if the blood dripped into the food. He even had to take care of his hair, so he must have attached great importance to food hygiene.
Ye Yonghuan walked out of the kitchen and inevitably bumped into him reading in the living room.
She lowered her head, but he noticed her fingers wrapped in tissue.
"What's wrong?"
"Uh..." She was startled because he dropped the book in his hand and ran to her quickly. She had never seen him look so nervous. "I cut my hand, sorry, clumsy."
"Go to the hospital!"
"W-what?! Please, no need!"
God! Is it too exaggerated? !
"What if I get a bacterial infection?"
Seeing him say such words seriously, she almost fainted. How could she have thought he was the smartest man in the world before and admired him to death?
Is this Su Jincang the one she knew before?
"It's impossible! A wound of this magnitude can be cured by just rubbing it with iodine and bandaging it."
"Really?"
She practically rolled her eyes and sighed. "Yes!"
His raised eyebrows were still suspicious, but in the end he nodded reluctantly. "Follow me, there's a first aid kit in the study."
He helped her apply the medicine himself, and his cautious expression made her hands tremble slightly.
"Does it hurt?"
"It's okay." The gentleness of his tone shocked her even more.
"Really?"
A long time after applying the medicine, he never let go of her hand. "I remember that you used to be very afraid of pain. You couldn't help but cry at the slightest pain."
Her face turned red, and when she heard him mention the past, she felt a strange kind of ambiguous emotion flowing through her. She didn't know whether he did it on purpose or unintentionally. In short, she didn't want to touch the dangerous topic of "the past", so she quickly said: "That was before, I have grown up."
"Really?" He was lost in thought, as if he was lost for a moment. "I hope you never change." Then he looked at her, stretched out his hand, touched her face, ears, and stroked her neck, as if to confirm something.
She was unable to move as if under a immobilizing spell.
Why is he doing this? Why are you looking at me like this?she? Why touch her?
She opened her mouth slightly, wanting to shout out these questions, but her throat seemed to be stuck and she couldn't make a sound.
He came closer to her, and his unique breath filled her senses, making her feel dizzy.
He smiled at her, and that handsome smile made her dumbfounded, and then his lips kissed her in a daze...
She blinked and blinked again, but the enlarged male face in front of her eyes did not disappear, so it was not a dream!
She gasped, suddenly realizing what was happening, pushed him away, and backed away in embarrassment. "No!"
He frowned and wanted to bring her back, but she was so frightened that she threw away his hand and ran away as if running away.
She was frightened, really frightened!
He shouldn't look at her with that expression, he shouldn't touch her, he shouldn't kiss her...
It's messed up, everything is messed up...
On the way home, Su Jincang made an unprecedented detour to the department store.
Except for his own clothes, he usually asks his assistant or secretary to buy most of the items on his behalf, not to mention giving half of them as gifts. He doesn't like shopping and thinks it's a waste of time.
But this week he walked into the department store on the second day.
Last time he bought a hairpin at the jewelry counter, this time he walked into an ice cream shop.
"Sir, do you need anything?"
Three sales ladies rushed to the door. They had rarely seen such a tall and handsome male customer come to the door. Everyone was looking forward to saying a few words to him, even if there was no performance, it didn't matter.
"I want ice cream as a gift." Today he specifically asked the female secretary which ice cream shop has the best ice cream. He had never paid attention to what Yong Huan liked before. He only remembered that she was very happy eating ice cream when he went to Germany that year.
"May I ask how old this person is?"
"Young woman."
The sales girls looked at each other and saw disappointment in each other's eyes. Such a well-off man really does have a sweetheart!
"Our ice cream emphasizes pure natural production, and there are different flavors to choose from. These types of ice cream are very popular among young women..." The sales lady introduced them one by one.
Su Jincang listened carefully and tasted each one. The sweet taste made him frown. I really don’t know why that guy likes to eat...
In the end he couldn't decide, so he bought a dozen. Although the shopping process wasted a lot of time, it was very pleasant to think of how happy and surprised she would be when she received the gift.
How come he didn't know that buying things for others was such a happy thing? The urge to pamper the other person and give the other person whatever she wants was so strong that it was the first time he felt it. He thought of the past, no matter what he wanted, no matter how beloved she was, she was willing to give it to him.
She said he was first in her heart, and now he seems to understand that sentiment a little bit.
Putting another person's needs before your own seems like a foolish and dangerous thing to do. However, he thought he didn't have to worry, because the other party would reciprocate his feelings in equal measure.
He was very sure about her. He believed that she still loved him. As long as he treated her better, gave her some gifts, and coaxed her, she would soon be as obsessed with him as before.
"The total is 2,500 yuan. Sir, your girlfriend is so lucky to have a boyfriend who loves her."
He just smiled and did not refute what the sales lady said, and ended up with two heavy bags.
When eating ice cream, she might show her happy smile again, right?
With such expectations, he happily paid and went home with the ice cream.
Chapter 8(2)
When he got home, he couldn't wait to walk into the kitchen.
"H-hello."
He didn't like the cautious and fearful look on her face every time she saw him, but he believed that today his secret weapon could make her take off her guard.
"Dinner will be ready soon."
"Don't worry, this is for you to eat."
Ye Yonghuan looked at the two big bags of ice cream he handed over in astonishment.
"You like to eat, right?"
She opened her mouth, but said noSpeak up.
Seeing her reaction, Su Jincang was secretly happy.
She will smile happily soon, right? He could see her happy face as she licked the ice cream, and then she would thank him and maybe ask for a kiss.
He remembered the feeling of kissing her, it was sweeter than all ice cream...
"No."
Her answer made him frown in displeasure.
"What do you mean by 'no'?"
"I can't accept your gift." She thrust the ice cream back into his hand.
The sheer rejection irritated him, and what she said next shocked him even more.
